name: L'Annuaire des Entreprises
description: L’Annuaire des Entreprises is the French government’s official search interface for legal information on companies, associations and public administrations. It resolves an entity to its SIREN and SIRET identifiers and presents data drawn from other administrations, including the Registre National des Entreprises and the Base Sirene, rather than holding a register of its own.

publicAccess.notes: The service is published as a free official search interface. The overall access posture was not exercised, so the level stays unknown.

bestFor: Resolving a French business name to its SIREN or SIRET identifier free of charge.
Getting an overview of an entity from several official sources before going to the originating register.
notRecommendedFor: Use as the legal source of record, which remains the Registre National des Entreprises, the Base Sirene or the other originating registers.
Obtaining a certified extract, which is issued by the originating register rather than by this interface.
pros: It is free to consult and is published by the French government as the official search interface for business information.
It resolves an entity to its SIREN and SIRET identifiers, which is what most French administrative processes key on.
It brings data from several administrations together in one place, including the Registre National des Entreprises, the Base Sirene and the Bulletin officiel des annonces civiles et commerciales.
The data it uses is published openly, so the same sources can be obtained directly rather than only through the interface.
cons: It is a consultation interface, not the legal source of record. The registers it draws on — the Registre National des Entreprises and the Base Sirene among them — remain the authoritative sources, and a legal question belongs to them.
Because it presents data assembled from several administrations, a discrepancy is resolved against the originating register rather than against this interface.
editorNotes: Verified 2026-08-04; source-of-record corrected 2026-08-05 (Wave 1D). CORRECTION: this record previously carried primaryRegistryType business-entity-register and described the service as a directory "publishing official legal information", which read as a claim to be the register. It is not. The service publishes itself as the official search engine, and its own data-sources page states that it uses the data of different administrations, all of it openly downloadable, listing among the sources the Registre National des Entreprises and the Base Sirene des Entreprises alongside BODACC and others. Reclassified to corporate-number-database, whose boundary note covers exactly this case: an identifier lookup is not automatically the legal register of the entity, and where the identifier is issued by a statistical body while incorporation happens elsewhere the record takes this type rather than company-register. Operator is unchanged and remains correct. Score unchanged: the interface is as useful and as trustworthy as before, and only its described legal role was wrong.
